scientific_integrity: The theorem and proof are self-contained. Finite numerical checks are corroborating evidence, not universal proofs. Related general SLEM formulations and known unweighted spectra are credited as prior results. Historical equivalents not located by the targeted comparisons remain possible.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric discrete-time stochastic kernels supported on cycle distance one and two, plus self-loops, for integers n>=5. Optimal value is global over nonuniform admissible matrices; uniqueness is proven only for the edge-class-uniform circulant subfamily. No claim of exact finite-time total-variation mixing ratios, optimal nonsymmetric walks, floating-point certification, or external independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact fastest symmetric mixing on two-hop cyclic networks
